parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, made of polypropylene plastic, typically rectangular with a slightly contoured surface for comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user, supporting body weight and distributing pressure evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It folds upward or downward along a hinge mechanism to allow the chair to collapse for storage.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the folding chair, including the frame and backrest, made of steel tubing for structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main structural integrity of the chair, supporting the seat and backrest while allowing folding motion.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots at the hinge joints to enable folding and unfolding of the chair, maintaining stability when in use.
